rules.title: Boston Fair Housing – Rental Assistance (Source of Income) Protection
rules.requirement: In Boston, landlords may not discriminate against renters based on rental assistance. This includes refusing to accept Section 8 vouchers, social security disability vouchers, or veterans vouchers.
rules.coverage_text: Renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for any housing in the City of Boston.
rules.quoted_span: In the City of Boston, it’s illegal to discriminate when renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for any housing.
